rows.basis: The Q1 2026 earnings release says Digital Realty is 'swiftly advancing hyperscale AI-oriented capacity in the U.S.', which links the development pipeline to AI demand in words only. No AI or hyperscale share or amount of development capex is stated. Development capex guidance is net of partner contributions, so JV-funded builds (for example the 288 MW Northern Virginia JV) sit off balance sheet and the gross build is larger.

The Q1 2024 earnings release cites 'multifaceted AI-oriented opportunities' amid accelerating demand. That is leasing demand attributed to AI in words only; no AI or hyperscale part of revenue or of new leasing is stated, and rent is not split by AI.

none_found.reason: No capex value in the pack and no AI or hyperscale statement for the year. Gross PP&E category changes measure data-center capacity and include acquisitions; the thesis does not allow equating data-center capex with AI.
